evidence.why: Exact callback inputs, clearing and masks.

facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline's conflation of the dispatcher pass mask with a GX-link index.
facts.value: Scene entry attaches the loaded camera to this callback's GObj and retains the loaded fog color in un_804D6FBC. After successful camera activation, the callback supplies that RGBA value as the erase color and enables color/depth clearing while disabling alpha clearing. It assigns gxlink_prios masks 9, 8, 8 and 0x8A1 for four calls to HSD_GObj_80390ED0. Each call's argument 7 selects render passes 0, 1 and 2, while gxlink_prios selects GX-link lists by set-bit index; these are not four draws on GX link 7.

evidence.why: Guard, group arguments, masks and finalization.

facts.rationale: Preserves the exceptional branch and ordered behavior while correcting individual-priority terminology to bitmask semantics.
facts.value: All erase, dispatch and finalization operations are guarded by a nonzero HSD_CObjSetCurrent result. On success the callback clears color and depth, selects camera groups with arguments 2, 1 and 0 while dispatching GX-link masks 9, 8 and 8, then dispatches mask 0x8A1 without another group change and calls HSD_CObjEndCurrent. Every dispatch uses render-pass mask 7. Mask 9 selects link lists 0 and 3; mask 8 selects list 3; mask 0x8A1 selects lists 0, 5, 7 and 11. If activation fails none of these guarded operations occurs.
